description: WDL Ground Surface Displacement - Land Subsidence Monitoring is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Department of Water Resources. Borehole extensometers are a more site specific method of measuring land subsidence. These instruments consist of a pipe or cable anchored at the bottom of a well casing. Pipe or cable extend from the bottom of the well, through geologic layers susceptible to compaction, to the ground surface. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Department of Water Resources. Its tags are california department of water resources, extensometer, groundwater, subsidence. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
